faqs.title: What is PocketVC?
faqs.description: PocketVC is a curated platform connecting European deep tech startups with the right investors. We focus on quality over quantity, ensuring meaningful connections.
faqs.icon: <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-blue-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M13 16h-1v-4h-1m1-4h.01M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"></path></svg>
faqs.content:
PocketVC is a curated platform connecting European deep tech startups with the right investors. We focus on quality over quantity, ensuring meaningful connections.

Unlike other platforms that flood investors with irrelevant opportunities, PocketVC uses intelligent matching to connect startups with investors who are genuinely interested in their sector, stage, and geography.

Our platform is designed specifically for the European deep tech ecosystem, understanding the unique challenges and opportunities in this space.

faqs.title: Who is PocketVC for?
faqs.description: PocketVC is designed for European deep tech startups seeking funding and investors looking for high-quality opportunities in the deep tech space.
faqs.content:
PocketVC is designed for European deep tech startups seeking funding and investors looking for high-quality opportunities in the deep tech space.

For Startups:

  • European deep tech companies
  • Pre-seed to Series A stage
  • Companies with strong IP or technical differentiation
  • Teams with deep technical expertise

For Investors:

  • VCs focused on deep tech
  • Corporate venture arms
  • Angel investors with technical backgrounds
  • Family offices interested in deep tech

faqs.title: How do I join PocketVC?
faqs.description: Joining PocketVC is simple. Startups can apply through our website, while investors can request access. We review all applications to maintain quality.
faqs.icon: <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-blue-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 6v6m0 0v6m0-6h6m-6 0H6"></path></svg>
faqs.content:
Joining PocketVC is simple. Startups can apply through our website, while investors can request access. We review all applications to maintain quality.

For Startups:

  1. Visit our signup page
  2. Complete the application form
  3. Upload your pitch deck and key documents
  4. Wait for our review (typically 1-2 weeks)
  5. Get matched with relevant investors

For Investors:

  1. Contact us through our contact page
  2. Provide your investment criteria
  3. Complete our verification process
  4. Start receiving curated opportunities

faqs.title: Is PocketVC free to use?
faqs.description: PocketVC offers free access for startups and investors. We believe in removing barriers to funding and making quality connections accessible to everyone.
faqs.icon: <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-blue-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 8c-1.657 0-3 .895-3 2s1.343 2 3 2 3 .895 3 2-1.343 2-3 2m0-8c1.11 0 2.08.402 2.599 1M12 8V7m0 1v8m0 0v1m0-1c-1.11 0-2.08-.402-2.599-1"></path></svg>
faqs.content:
PocketVC offers free access for startups and investors. We believe in removing barriers to funding and making quality connections accessible to everyone.

Our platform is currently free to use for both startups and investors. We're focused on building the best possible matching system and growing our community.

In the future, we may introduce premium features for advanced matching and analytics, but the core platform will always remain free for basic usage.

faqs.title: How do you protect my data and privacy?
faqs.description: We take data protection seriously. All data is encrypted, we comply with GDPR, and we never share your information without consent. Learn more about our privacy practices.
faqs.icon: <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-blue-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 15v2m-6 4h12a2 2 0 002-2v-6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v6a2 2 0 002 2zm10-10V7a4 4 0 00-8 0v4h8z"></path></svg>
faqs.content:
We take data protection seriously. All data is encrypted, we comply with GDPR, and we never share your information without consent. Learn more about our privacy practices.

Data Protection:

  • All data is encrypted in transit and at rest
  • We comply with GDPR and other privacy regulations
  • Regular security audits and penetration testing
  • Limited access to personal data

Privacy Controls:

  • You control what information is shared
  • Easy data export and deletion
  • Transparent privacy policy
  • No selling of personal data

For more details, please read our privacy policy.
